authority: Root在用户已授权单次版本补证及最新查因推进要求内，明确metadata准入实现映射及逐job临时guard边界；不是人类逐字批准具体mapping/manager配置，也不是新资源授权。

admission.stage: one metadata-only collector under sustained supervisor and independent fallback
preserved_checks: immutable root-owned controller/config/epoch permit and fixed role/unit/argv bindings
actual own cgroup and shared64/project512 memory/swap/oom gates before activation
protected root administrative controllers only; no Subject or token access
same absolute270/300 with revoke/stop/kill/reap/restoration and independent physical final witness

clock.t0: Workflow captures time.monotonic before /run controller/config creation and before any guard/unit setup; literal parsing/imports collect no versions.
clock.manager_secondary_bound: RuntimeMaxSec recomputed from original remaining; SIGKILL controls before outer as secondary only.
clock.always: Read-only actual resource evidence and saved terminal; no new cleanup/restoration/grace.

topology_and_reference.reused: COW management children, monotonic remaining, nonblocking kernel writes, bounded stop/show/noJob, cleanup-once receipts, epoch permits, protected controls, postdrop reread, independent fallback and physical final witness.
topology_and_reference.changed_for_metadata: Common xiongbaowork-metadata.slice64 added under ordinary project512; all controls+collector counted. No original Source/runtime/install/prepare/brand or A/B operations.
topology_and_reference.scope_specific: Supervisor uses normal systemd-run --scope so registered PID execs controller, STDIO inherits Actions descriptor; collector --pipe client is inside supervisor.scope16. No long outside DATA-forwarding client.
topology_and_reference.scope_exit: Actual command returncode plus inactive/failed noJob and physical scope empty/absent-after-exit; no service MainPID success assumption.
topology_and_reference.actual_platform_support: NOT_RUN; unsupported/rejected scope or other primitive fails closed, no guessed fallback.

temporary_operations.operation: Create immutable controller.py0444 and privateconfig0600 under exact /run/xb-platform-<run>-<attempt>
temporary_operations.scope: This run only, root-owned O_EXCL; t0 already running; no version or Source read.
Fixed per-job resource guard definitions, O_EXCL collision rejects; no /etc or manager-global policy/enable.
Only make fixed ephemeral resource guards available. No service upgrade/install/persistent enable or network probe.

temporary_operations.operation: Initial actual512/shared64/swap0/empty checks then kernel oom.group1 admission
temporary_operations.scope: Fixed bootstrap guard setup only; unexpected memory/swap/populated rejects before collector.

temporary_operations.operation: Fallback transient.service16 and supervisor.scope16; collector.service32 with fixedrootwrapper
temporary_operations.scope: Common64; every subsequent management/command descendant counted; all runtime caps read back, unsupported properties fail.
Only supervisor/fallback inside common64 and only original remainder. No outside restore writer.

temporary_operations.operation: Final physical project/shared limits+pop0 and owned control quiet evidence
temporary_operations.scope: Fixed outside normal Actions read-only witness; saves only its own administrative observations, never reads/parses version payload or Subject.

temporary_restoration_boundary: Restores original job resource baseline project512/shared64/swap0/oom1 and proves whole aggregates empty. Fixed temporary unit definitions remain for exact final evidence until ephemeral runner teardown; no claim of persistent/global manager configuration restoration. Existing final oom0/absent/missing/late conditions keep whole job FAILED_OR_UNKNOWN.

metadata_allowlist.binary: Normal /proc/1/exe readlink and binary FD hash; allowlisted root-owned /usr/lib/systemd/systemd or /lib/systemd/systemd --version/hash; missing permission or running/disk mismatch remains UNKNOWN, never privileged fallback.
metadata_allowlist.package: Only dpkg-query -S exact validated systemd binary and -W systemd with binary:Package, fullVersion, Architecture, source:Package, source:Version, installed status. Patch names are full version metadata, not vendor patch-content proof.
metadata_allowlist.os: Bounded root-owned stable os-release data with ID/VERSION_ID/VERSION/PRETTY_NAME/BUILD_ID only; no source/eval.
metadata_allowlist.runner_image_provisioner: Coordinator joins native setup metadata of this exact newrun/job; collector does not read environment or usernames.
metadata_allowlist.prohibitions: No token, network probe, Source/oldexports/SQL/SDK/packageinstall/upgrade/userdata/globalmanager edits. No metadata field is inferred from Ubuntu name; no backfill to prior runs.

output.transport: Collector stdout through in-scope client and inherited ActionsFD. Raw32768 report never goes through8192 call_bounded management pipe.
output.privileged_resources: Separate root-owned receipts from actual kernel/systemctl reads only. Unprivileged metadata cannot attest restoration.
output.status: Per-query unsupported/timeout/outputcap/permission errors explicitUNKNOWN. A complete bounded metadata report may exist even when final resource gate fails.

controller.usage: Exact bytes also inline immutable in workflow, no runtime code/network fetch.

proof_level: Author construction/connector byte identities only; no local parser/compile/test/collector/job execution; no self-review approval.
next_action: Different nonauthor reads every exact implementation byte, inline/controller parity and this operation map. Only sole current valid leaseowner after idlequeue/dedup can one-time create exact runbranch. No dispatch by author; version capture is not final resource acceptance or project adoption.
